Hi Camila —

Appreciate you following up and for the materials. I’m sorry to say that we need to pause the demo for now. Our priority has shifted toward a cross-functional search/merchandising effort and leadership has put a hold on new inference initiatives until Q3 while they re-evaluate budget and roadmap.

Two concrete things driving this:
- Senior ops leads are traveling for a 3-week field program, making coordination tough.
- Finance has instituted a short freeze on discretionary pilots until the roadmap review completes.

Given that, could we park the demo and circle back in ~6–8 weeks? If anything changes earlier I’ll reach out. For now please stop the scheduling cadence — we don’t want to waste your team’s time.

Thanks for understanding,
Derek
VP, Engineering | NovaRetail
Derek.Holmes@novaretail.com

- We’re happy to hold a 30-minute optional office hours demo for the core team when they’re back from travel — no pressure on commitments.

If it’s OK with you I’ll plan to check back in 6–8 weeks (targeting early May) and we’ll be flexible on timing. If you’d prefer a different cadence, say 8–10 weeks, tell me and I’ll adjust.

Also copying Ben and Marissa so they’re aware. Ben — Marissa — feel free to save the proposal and QA sheet to the deal folder; I’ll drop a light pilot checklist into the thread now (attached).
